notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Izzet Chronarch is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch that's tapped and attacking.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
